description: This Java source file defines the KeyboardFactory class, which extends AddOnsFactory.MultipleAddOnsFactory to manage keyboard add-ons for the AnySoftKeyboard project. It handles loading keyboard configurations from XML resources, creating keyboard add-on instances, and managing default settings.
